records.title: Return to inventory
records.body:
West Depot keeps an electronic bay register. Drivers must present a seal number and trailer temperature at reception. An initial temperature difference can be logged as a supplier advisory. Shift supervisors receive a separate queue for unlabeled samples.

At West Depot the operations lead may restore chilled pallets to sale after a continuous forty-five-minute logger trace within range.

Use the local manifest to assign a barcode to each pallet. Delivery photos remain in the warehouse audit folder; copies can be requested by inventory control. The equipment register contains the calibration owner for each logger. Drivers sign the arrival sheet before a departure dock is assigned.

records.title: Disposition record
records.body: When packaging is damp on the outside but its inner liner is dry, isolate the pallet for a packaging inspection.

records.title: Timing reference
records.body: Forty-five minutes is the interval for receiving supervisors to update the board during a network outage.

records.title: Dock cleaning
records.body: Document standing water using a location photograph before the cleaning crew enters.

records.title: Logger audit
records.body: The maintenance office keeps calibration files for eighteen months.
